description: Canonical machine context for Arden and other AI tools. Not a visual roadmap copy: short contract of version, hard architecture rules, accepted work, and next actions.

architectureRules.rule: createExpense() is the only production entry point for new expenses
Training mode requires explicit user confirmation for every new expense; Assistant mode is not enabled
Ledger accounts are the source of truth for money on accounts; funds and plans are not reconciliation targets
Funds are allocation of own money, not accounts
Credit limit is not own money and is not a fund
fundId on an expense is optional
Personal and Business wallets remain separate ledgers with different fields
AI proposes and ranks; the user decides duplicates and confirmations
Purchase is mandatory: sources[] (bank/receipt/…) and expenses[]; never skip Purchase
Bank source is truth for money movement on accounts; receipt is truth for purchase composition
Receipt upload means line-item expenses via createExpense after Training confirmation in the shared tutor flow; no store-specific parsers
Duplicate matching for bank↔receipt runs at Purchase level, not line-item level

One confirmation UI only: Valet tutor cards. One card = one expense (no groupValetTutorItems, no Группа N из M, no Верно · все N). Resume unfinished review in the same tutor interface, never a second screen.
Unified search; bank.comment≠productName; reconLinks after Да одна запись → silent skip; day+amount alone never skip; card↔account optional remember

All expense sources share one pipeline: source → recognize → find existing → new/doubtful proposals → Valet tutor → user confirm → createExpense(). Source difference is data-only (sourceType), never a separate UX or write path.

Honest failure: unrecognized import shows a modal (what happened + tips) and logs to existing /logs via reportUserError; no secrets/receipt body/amounts; partial recognition offers Continue with N of M; logging failure must not hide the modal
Receipt line = expense fields unit/qty/price/amount; any price×qty≉amount → doubt and ask in Razbor; Valet never auto-fixes; fields preserved through createExpense()

acceptance: Ledger row counts and account balances unchanged
